essentialTerminology.definition: The Church's living teaching office, exercised by the pope and bishops in communion, serving the word of God rather than standing above it.
The people gathered by the Father through Christ in the Holy Spirit, at once spiritual communion and visible apostolic society.
God's free and undeserved gift of divine life and help, healing and elevating the human person.
God's gracious forgiveness and interior renewal by which a sinner is made righteous in Christ.

The Jerusalem gathering resolves a disputed missionary question through testimony, scriptural reasoning, apostolic deliberation, and a decision attributed to the Holy Spirit.
The Church receives one faith and diverse ministries so that the whole body may grow into mature unity in Christ.
